notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Another update to Dubio is now live! Here's what we changed:
- Improved performance and reduced memory use
- Exiting the reset data menu will now cancel the operation
- Setting values are no longer reset when progress is reset

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
We've just pushed a new patch that addresses the known issues in Dubio! Here's a summary of what we've fixed:
- Improved clarity around resetting progress from the menu
- Fixed one level incorrectly marked on the level select
- Ball rolling SFX now plays while in reversed gravity
- Fixed some hitches due to dynamic quality
- Ensured achievements earned in the demo are granted in full game
- Fix inverted D-Pad mapping in the menu
- Demo version remains locked even if you own the full game

notes.title: Developer Playthrough and Q&A
notes.notes:
Hi, it's Richard Boeser. I'm the designer of Dubio, our minimalist puzzle platformer.
I'll be playing through Dubio's demo and will give you a peak at what more the full game has to offer. Also I'll be happy to answer any of your questions.
